---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 20.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0

res = optimize_glider_3mm(verbose=False)
glider = make_glider_3mm(res["c_root"], res["taper"], res["cg_x"])
wing = glider.wings[0]
area_density = 0.10464  # kg/m^2
wing_mass_g = wing.area() * area_density * 1000
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{wing_mass_g:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[g]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The optimized 3 mm wing alone weighs `{python} f"{wing_mass_g:.2f}"` g, given a planform area of `{python} f"{wing.area():.3f}"` m² and foam area density of `{python} f"{area_density * 1000:.1f}"` g/m².
